benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Extended its slide to about $96.06 on 5 Nov (Trading Economics), up $1.44 (1.5%) on the day but down roughly 16% for the week, after closing below $100 on 4 Nov for the first time since late September as Democrats' Nov 3 midterm win fed bets on reduced political pressure to continue the Iran war. Week-ago is this site's 30 Oct reading.

note: Oil and European gas extended their slide on 5 November after Democrats won control of Congress in the Nov 3 US midterms; Vice President Vance and President Trump both linked the Republican losses to the Iran war's effect on gasoline prices. Brent closed below $100/bbl on 4 Nov for the first time since late September. New Iranian claims of tankers destroyed by mines in the strait remain unverified.
